cohort: The study included 54 pregnant women diagnosed with uterine fibroids via ultrasonography, identified from 6142 antenatal visits.
finding: Pregnancy with uterine fibroids was associated with various untoward obstetric outcomes, including spontaneous miscarriages (14.81%), pain abdomen (32.6%), and low birth weight (34%).
mod_finding: Among the pregnancies that continued, 51.8% resulted in Lower Segment Caesarean Sections (LSCS) and 33.27% in vaginal deliveries.
